clue.text: Proven right victor pointed out

parts.note: Victor is the NATO phonetic alphabet word for the letter V
to have pointed out something is to have indicated it

explanation.surface: A winner's claim is said to be vindicated once someone draws attention to it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'victor' looks like a winner, but it is only the letter V from the radio alphabet.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone shown to have been correct all along has been justified, cleared by events.

clue.text: Formally reject having check on leader of organisation

parts.note: to vet something is to check it over carefully

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter, so take the opening letter of organisation

explanation.surface: An official blocks a proposal after the head of the organisation reviews it.
explanation.definitionFit: A formal refusal by someone with authority, such as a president blocking a bill, is this kind of rejection.

clue.text: Name record, piece of music, part of an orchestral suite

parts.note: an EP is an extended-play record
a tune is a piece of music

explanation.surface: A list of items: a name, a recording, a tune, a movement of a suite.
explanation.walkthrough: Holst's orchestral suite The Planets has a movement named after this planet.
explanation.definitionFit: Holst's The Planets contains a movement titled after the eighth planet, the mystic, so it is one section of that suite.

clue.text: Family matter

definitions.meaning: a topic or point under discussion

explanation.surface: A domestic problem that needs sorting out.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both children or descendants and a subject of debate or concern.

clue.text: Attribute of a writer

parts.note: a scribe is a writer, especially one who copies documents

explanation.surface: A literary critic notes some quality belonging to a certain author.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Attribute' reads as a noun, a quality, but here it is the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To attribute a work to someone is to credit it to them, the verb sense here.

clue.text: Sovereign in capital keeping agent up

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the whole assembly is read from bottom to top
keeping means the capital holds the agent within it

parts.note: Rome is the capital of Italy
a rep, or representative, is an agent for a firm

explanation.surface: A monarch has a spy stationed in the capital city.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'up' reads the whole assembly from the bottom upwards, after 'keeping' has placed the agent within the city.
explanation.definitionFit: A supreme monarch ruling an empire is a sovereign of the highest rank.

clue.text: Box available for use, no end

indicators.note: no end means the word loses its final letter

parts.note: something spare is extra and available for use

explanation.surface: A boxing ring is free to use, with no finish time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'no end' takes the final E off SPARE.
explanation.definitionFit: To spar is to box, especially in practice bouts with a partner.

clue.text: In lab, cope with modifying clinical trial 'drug'?

indicators.note: modifying means the letters of lab and cope are changed into a new order

explanation.surface: Lab workers cope with altering what they give patients in a medical trial.
explanation.walkthrough: 'modifying' rearranges LABCOPE. The quotation marks and question mark flag that the 'drug' is not a real one.
explanation.definitionFit: A dummy pill with no active ingredient, given to a control group in medical testing, is a fake medicine.

clue.text: False lead embarrassed Hercule, initially getting it wrong

parts.note: someone embarrassed goes red in the face

indicators.note: initially means the first letter of Hercule

parts.note: erring means making a mistake

explanation.surface: Agatha Christie's detective Hercule Poirot is blushing at a mistaken clue.
explanation.definitionFit: A misleading clue planted to distract detectives or readers from the truth is the term here.

clue.text: Wisecrack aboard English ship

parts.note: to be aboard is to be on a vessel
a liner is a large passenger ship

explanation.surface: A joke told on board a British passenger vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: A short witty remark delivered in a single sentence is a quip.

clue.text: Thanks Pedro, firstly when bringing appetisers

parts.note: ta is British informal for thank you

indicators.note: firstly means take the first letter of Pedro

parts.note: as can mean when, as in 'as he arrived'

explanation.surface: Thanking Pedro, a Spanish waiter, as he brings out the starters.
explanation.definitionFit: Small Spanish snack dishes served with drinks are starters or bar nibbles.

clue.text: Better being done humbly

parts.note: to cap something is to better or top it
a job in hand is one being done, currently under way

explanation.surface: It is better that a task is performed with humility.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Better' looks like an adjective; it is the verb, to top.
explanation.definitionFit: Asking with one's hat held before oneself is the idiom for approaching in a meek, deferential way.

clue.text: Arrogant police officer, one facing other ranks

parts.note: a super is a police superintendent
I is the Roman numeral one
OR is the military abbreviation for other ranks, soldiers who are not officers

explanation.surface: A haughty senior policeman confronts the ordinary soldiers.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone with a condescending manner who looks down on others acts haughtily.

clue.text: Loyal subject, for example, in fiction

indicators.note: in means the abbreviation sits inside the untruth

parts.note: a lie is a fiction, an untruth

explanation.surface: A faithful vassal appearing, say, in a novel.
explanation.definitionFit: In feudal terms the word means a vassal owing allegiance to a lord, a faithful subject.

clue.text: Happy carol, treated as unauthenticated

indicators.note: treated means the letters of happy carol are processed into a new form

explanation.surface: A cheerful Christmas song regarded as of doubtful origin.
explanation.definitionFit: A story of dubious authenticity, widely told but probably untrue, is described this way, after the non-canonical books of the Bible.

clue.text: Quietly tell high-ranking member of the clergy

parts.note: p, piano, is the musical direction for quietly
to relate a story is to tell it

explanation.surface: Whisper something to a bishop.
explanation.definitionFit: A bishop, abbot or other senior churchman is a cleric of high rank.

clue.text: Organiser may show irritation having to support a bishop

indicators.note: in a down clue, the irritation sits below and so supports the a and bishop pieces

parts.note: RR, Right Reverend, is the title abbreviation for a bishop
anger is strong irritation

explanation.surface: A planner gets annoyed at having to back a bishop.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who sets things in order or plans an event is the one who sorts things out; also one who adapts music.

clue.text: Bitterness of promoted soldier, we hear

indicators.note: we hear signals that the word is spoken and sounds like the entry

parts.note: a ranker is an officer promoted from the ranks

explanation.surface: The resentment felt by a soldier who has risen through the ranks.
explanation.definitionFit: Deep-seated resentment or ill will is long-lasting bitterness.

clue.text: Series about King George may cause acute annoyance

indicators.note: about means the series goes round the king's letters

parts.note: a chain is a series of linked things
GR, Georgius Rex, is King George's royal cipher

explanation.surface: A run of programmes about George could greatly annoy viewers.
explanation.definitionFit: Vexation from humiliation or disappointment is a sharp irritation.

clue.text: Generally, a game may be found in auction

indicators.note: found in means the game sits inside the auction word

parts.note: a sale is an auction
RU is rugby union

explanation.surface: Typically, a board game can be picked up at an auction.
explanation.definitionFit: Usually, in most cases, is what the phrase means.

clue.text: Retsina being drunk is more unpleasant

indicators.note: being drunk suggests the letters of retsina are reeling into a new order

explanation.surface: Drinking retsina, a resinous Greek wine, makes things worse.
explanation.definitionFit: Comparative of a word meaning horrible or vile, so worse in an offensive way.

clue.text: Convoy a Republican's taken through Irish county

indicators.note: taken through means the a and Republican pieces pass inside the county name

parts.note: Cavan is a county in Ireland
R is the abbreviation for Republican

explanation.surface: A procession of vehicles carries a Republican across rural Ireland.
explanation.definitionFit: A group of travellers, vehicles or animals journeying together is a train or procession.

clue.text: Box of cutlery in a mess?

definitions.meaning: a case holding a set of knives, forks and spoons
a mess is a military dining room

explanation.surface: A cutlery box left in disorder.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mess' looks like disorder but is a dining hall.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a fitted case of table cutlery and a workplace or barracks dining room.

clue.text: Meat cooked in ovens

indicators.note: cooked means the letters of in ovens are worked over into a new order

explanation.surface: Meat being roasted in the oven.
explanation.definitionFit: Deer flesh eaten as food is a game meat.

clue.text: Long tale about last in residence

indicators.note: about means the story goes round that letter

parts.note: a yarn is a long story or tale

indicators.note: last in means take the final letter of residence

explanation.surface: A lengthy story about the newest occupant of a house.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Long' looks like an adjective, but it is the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To long for something is to crave or pine for it.

clue.text: Conscious of feeling many originally ignored

indicators.note: ignored means that letter is left out of the feeling word

parts.note: a sentiment is a feeling

indicators.note: originally means the first letter of many

explanation.surface: Aware of an emotion that most people overlook.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ignored' drops M (the first of 'many') from SENTIMENT.
explanation.definitionFit: A being able to perceive and feel things is aware, conscious in the broad sense.

clue.text: Suggest just taking son out

indicators.note: taking, paired with out, means the son is removed from the word for just
out completes taking out, the removal of the son letter from the word for just

parts.note: simply means just, merely

explanation.surface: A hint that it is only a matter of taking the boy out.
explanation.definitionFit: To hint at something without stating it outright is to insinuate or suggest.

clue.text: Look after stronghold

definitions.meaning: to take care of or maintain
the main fortified tower of a castle

explanation.surface: Guard the fortress.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means to tend or maintain and also a castle's central fortified tower.

clue.text: There's value in how I iron

definitions.text: There's value in how I iron

indicators.note: in means the value word sits within the other pieces

parts.note: use is value, as in 'of no use'
Fe is the chemical symbol for iron

explanation.surface: A homemaker boasting of how worthwhile their ironing is.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue doubles as the definition: a homemaker at the ironing board, describing the worth of her chores.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman who runs a home, doing chores such as ironing, is the traditional homemaker.

clue.text: Spread beyond Spain

parts.note: past means beyond, as in 'past the church'
E is the international vehicle code for Spain

explanation.surface: Something spreading out past the Spanish border.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Spread' could be a verb, but the noun is meant: something to spread on bread.
explanation.definitionFit: A soft mixture such as fish or meat paste is spread on bread.

clue.text: Vegetable in line that's scary!

parts.note: eek is a cry of fright, as at something scary

explanation.surface: A frightening vegetable in a row of crops.
explanation.definitionFit: An onion-family vegetable, the national emblem of Wales, is a garden vegetable.

clue.text: Biscuit: particular kind plant recalled

parts.note: a brand is a particular kind, as in 'a brand of humour'

indicators.note: recalled means the plant is called back, read in reverse

parts.note: a pansy is a garden plant

explanation.surface: Remembering a certain variety of plant from a biscuit packet.
explanation.definitionFit: A thin crisp rolled ginger wafer, often filled with cream, is a British sweet treat.
